parrafo.es: Duprey's Tree Service es un equipo local que atiende Ocala y sus alrededores, en el condado de Marion. George Duprey y su cuadrilla llegan con el equipo adecuado para remociones, podas, molienda de tocones y limpieza después de tormentas, cuidando la propiedad en cada trabajo.
parrafo.en: Duprey's Tree Service is a local crew serving Ocala and the surrounding area in Marion County. George Duprey and his crew show up with the right equipment for removals, trimming, stump grinding and storm cleanup, taking care of the property on every job.

hero.imagen_alt: Duprey's Tree Service crew working with a bucket truck and equipment under live oaks near Ocala, FL

parrafo_1.es: Duprey's Tree Service es un equipo local que atiende Ocala y el condado de Marion, trabajando desde remociones completas hasta poda, molienda de tocones y limpieza de árboles caídos.
parrafo_1.en: Duprey's Tree Service is a local crew serving Ocala and Marion County, working everything from full tree removals to trimming, stump grinding and cleanup of fallen trees.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten lo mismo en sus reseñas de Google: George conoce cómo podar un árbol para mantener su salud, su cuadrilla es rápida y cuidadosa, y dejan la propiedad limpia al terminar.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing in their Google reviews: George knows how to trim a tree to keep it healthy, his crew is fast and careful, and they leave the property clean when the job is done.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas: remoción, poda, molienda de tocón o limpieza de tormenta.
texto.en: Tell us what you need: removal, trimming, stump grinding or storm cleanup.

texto.es: El equipo revisa el árbol o la propiedad y te da un precio claro antes de empezar.
texto.en: The crew looks at the tree or the property and gives you a clear price before starting.

texto.es: Llegan con el camión y el equipo adecuado, y trabajan con cuidado alrededor de tu propiedad.
texto.en: They show up with the truck and the right equipment, and work carefully around your property.

texto.es: Se van dejando el área limpia, tal como describen sus clientes en Google.
texto.en: They leave the area clean, exactly as their clients describe on Google.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el árbol y el alcance. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the tree and the scope of work. Call and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Remoción completa de árboles, incluso ejemplares grandes, con el equipo y la cuadrilla para hacerlo de forma segura.
texto.en: Full tree removal, including large trees, with the equipment and crew to get it done safely.

texto.es: Poda que mantiene la salud y la forma del árbol, hecha por alguien que conoce cómo cortar sin dañarlo.
texto.en: Trimming that keeps a tree healthy and well shaped, done by someone who knows how to cut without damaging it.

texto.es: Retiro de tocones para dejar el terreno listo, sin dejar rastro del árbol que estaba ahí.
texto.en: Stump removal to leave your lot ready, with no trace of the tree that used to be there.

texto.es: Remoción de árboles y ramas caídas tras una tormenta, despejando tu propiedad con cuidado.
texto.en: Removal of fallen trees and limbs after a storm, clearing your property with care.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto en la lista? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your project listed? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: We got great service from the gang at Duprey's Tree Service, at a very reasonable price. They have the equipment to get the job done right. Thank you.

Duprey's tree service is the best tree service you will ever find. George and his crew will take care of you like it's nobody's business. Honest and reliable if you need trees trimmed Duprey's is the way to go.

I would give the job they did an A++. They were on time. Took down two trees, one being about 85 ft tall, in just a little over 2 hours. They cleaned up so well, you wouldn't even know there were two trees there before.
